subject: Civic Hall Wayback CDX review for January 2016 CouncilStat hackathon evidence
methodSummary: Public-safe review of Civic Hall Wayback CDX captures, URL keys, event URL paths, successful captures, redirects, not-found captures, and embedded social-feed evidence relevant to the January 30, 2016 CouncilStat hackathon context.
findings: Archived Civic Hall pages preserve relevant Civic Hall and New York City Council posts through an embedded social feed.
The Civic Hall post supports January 30, advertised 1-3 p.m., and constituent-services focus.
The New York City Council post supports event day, Civic Hall venue context, and first CouncilStat hackathon wording.
The RSVP short link resolves to a Civic Hall-domain Google Form.
The form is unavailable and no archived form contents were recovered.
negativeFindings: No dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing recovered.
publicSummary: A July 2026 public-safe review recovered embedded social-feed evidence but did not recover a dedicated calendar listing, event-detail page, full agenda, breakout roster, or registration-form contents.
